read_stata_file: read a Stata .dta file into a pandas DataFrame with automatic type conversion
read_stata_chunked: read a large Stata .dta file in chunks using the iterator interface
write_stata_dta: write a pandas DataFrame to a Stata .dta file with value labels and variable labels
write_stata_117: write a pandas DataFrame to Stata 13 format with strL support for long strings
write_stata_utf8: write a pandas DataFrame to Stata 15/16 format with full unicode string support
